title: Execution-topology-consistent real-SWAP physical tangent estimator
question: Can physical q_swap(H) tangent acquisition be made stable across both fragmented corrector admissibility and temporal-substep topology changes by admitting only probe results that share the center trial's execution topology?
frozen_boundary_states: Same eight negative/positive extreme states frozen in GC_FIXED_INTERFACE_G09_PREREGISTRATION.json.

execution_signature.equality_rule: A probe is topology-compatible only when all integer execution fields exactly equal the current center trial and the raw trial is complete/ready.

rule: Evaluate center participant trial and raw diagnostics; center must be status 0 and complete/ready.
At each d evaluate h-d,h+d,h-2d,h+2d from immutable accepted origin.
Mark a probe eligible only if participant status is 0 and its execution signature exactly matches the center.
If h-d and h+d are eligible, use the central secant.
Otherwise, if h-d and h-2d are eligible, use the fixed second-order backward derivative.
Otherwise, if h+d and h+2d are eligible, use the fixed second-order forward derivative.
Require a finite negative slope; no hard-coded admissible direction.

consistency_gate.method: Recompute E2 starting at half the selected d with the same topology rule.

required_specific_outcomes: C2_HIGH_FORCING negative dh=-5e-6: E0 central remains unavailable, E2 becomes available and topology-consistent.
C3_LONG_HIGH positive dh=+2e-6: E2 must reject the large positive-probe temporal-topology branch and achieve <=5% half-step consistency without changing tolerance.
All eight frozen boundary states produce an E2 tangent satisfying the same <=5% consistency gate.
groundwater_regimes: Reuse all three unchanged G08 groundwater regimes and independently remeasure each groundwater response.
policies: P1-E2 raw physical Newton using E2 at each outer iterate.
P4-E2 same E2 tangent plus fixed factor-1/2 backtracking on corrector inadmissibility or residual increase.
hard_rules: Every participant probe and policy candidate remains trial->evaluate->discard until a separate production admission work unit.
G09 remains falsified; G09B is a new estimator, not a relabeling of G09.
No production HCOF/RHS or coupling source change.
